REAL DECODE is MLP decode arithmetic 4.7895 ms (497.4 → 329.6 on the same 83.56 MB; organ 15.541 vs 10.7515 ms); fold_addqx saved 3.9833 ms on the complete token and is NOT bit-identical. COMPLETE TOKEN incumbent 26.3026 ms GPU / 22.3192 fold_addqx, host ceremony 0.9894 ms (separate column), DeltaNet state-to-consume stall 0.1821 ms (named, not absorbed). UNATTRIBUTED 1.4699 ms.
